$comment: Routing cases for the ui-colors skill. label: system = scripts/system.mjs, source = scripts/generate.cjs, none = the skill should not run. Run by hand with a fresh model (evals/README.md).

cases.prompt: Make me a light and dark theme for my app with CSS variables, built around brand blue #0a4dff.
cases.label: system
cases.why: light and dark, CSS variables, brand anchor

cases.prompt: I want Radix-style 12-step colour scales with alpha steps, but generated, not copied from Radix.
cases.label: system

cases.prompt: Give me six chart colours that work in both light and dark mode and survive colour blindness.
cases.label: system
cases.why: data series per mode, CVD check

cases.prompt: Generate DTCG colour tokens with semantic roles (primary, critical, success) and a high-contrast mode.
cases.label: system

cases.prompt: Our brand paper is #f6f2ea and ink is #1c1a17 — build a colour system around them with Figma variables.
cases.label: system

cases.prompt: Generate a palette for my design system and tell me which text/background pairs fail WCAG AA.
cases.label: system
cases.why: the system generator reports an APCA contrast matrix (WCAG 2 ratio as information only); a palette plus pairs means roles

cases.prompt: Use color(display-p3 0 0.8 0.3) as our success colour in a P3 light/dark theme.
cases.label: system
cases.why: anchor in a wide-gamut space, modes

cases.prompt: Give me a Base 050–950 range plus the seven Primes for hue 140.
cases.label: source

cases.prompt: Six balanced HCT palettes starting at 20 degrees, with system and Material palettes.
cases.label: source

cases.prompt: Turn oklch(0.62 0.18 265) into a tonal 050–950 ramp I can paste into Figma as a style library.
cases.label: source
cases.why: one source colour to a 050–950 ramp, no modes or roles

cases.prompt: I need a nice tonal palette from my brand colour #3366cc.
cases.label: source
cases.why: a palette from one colour with no modes, roles or tokens: a source palette (ask if the user then mentions UI theming)

cases.prompt: Map these existing tokens to semantic roles in my app's Tailwind config.
cases.label: none
cases.why: editing an existing app's token mapping; generating colours was not asked

cases.prompt: Pick a font pairing for my landing page.
cases.label: none
none
cases.why: a single conversion; no palette or system

cases.prompt: Fix the legend overlap in my Recharts bar chart.
cases.label: none

cases.prompt: Does white text on #767676 pass WCAG AA?
cases.label: none
cases.why: one contrast question about given colours; nothing to generate
